description.p: Seshat is a native Wayland file manager for Linux. It focuses on reliable file operations that you can follow, cancel and recover from, and on a clean interface that adapts to your theme.

ul.li: List and grid views, search, natural sorting and multi-selection
Copy, move, rename, Trash and restore with progress, cancellation and conflict resolution
Operations keep running when the window is closed
Other applications can follow file operations over D-Bus
